title: CopilotApi
description: Describes all JSON-RPC methods exposed by the Copilot CLI server. SDK codegen tools consume this to produce typed client wrappers.
notes: This file is vendored verbatim so the build is reproducible without a sibling npm install.
Do not hand-edit. Re-vendor from the pinned @github/copilot version when bumping the protocol.
src/generated/ is produced from this file and must never be hand-edited.
